thought.text:
Ini **OpenHands Cloud** (v1.62.0), bukan lokal. Jadi konfigurasinya lewat GUI `app.all-hands.dev`.

Saya cek apakah API profil LLM bisa diakses.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && for u in "http://127.0.0.1:60000/api/settings" "http://127.0.0.1:60000/api/llm/profiles" "http://127.0.0.1:60000/api/v1/settings"; do printf "%-45s " "$u"; curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 15 -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "X-Session-API-Key: $SESSION_API_KEY" "$u"; done; echo "SESSION_API_KEY set? ${SESSION_API_KEY:+ya}"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && for u in \"http://127.0.0.1:60000/api/settings\" \"http://127.0.0.1:60000/api/llm/profiles\" \"http://127.0.0.1:60000/api/v1/settings\"; do printf \"%-45s \" \"$u\"; curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 15 -w \"%{http_code}\\n\" -H \"X-Session-API-Key: $SESSION_API_KEY\" \"$u\"; done; echo \"SESSION_API_KEY set? ${SESSION_API_KEY:+ya}\"", "summary": "Probe local OpenHands settings API", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 120}
